snippet.title: BROKENLORE: UNFOLLOW | Horror Game Awards 2025
snippet.description:
BrokenLore: UNFOLLOW is a first-person psychological horror that delves into the impact of social media on mental health. Step into the story of Anne, a bullying victim trapped in a surreal nightmare, where she must unravel a dark mystery and confront sinister creatures.

👉 Wishlist BROKENLORE: UNFOLLOW on Steam + PlayStation
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133830/UNFOLLOW/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10008188

🎮 Discover more BROKENLORE titles on Steam + PlayStation
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/search/brokenlore

📲 Follow us on social media
X (Twitter): https://twitter.com/UNFOLLOW_GAME
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/serafiniproductions/ ---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://www.thehorrorgameawards.com/store
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TheHorrorGameAwards

Discord: https://discord.gg/j8wUUzJQ8D
